sources.lines: X-ray line energies and relative weights: exspy element database (exspy._misc.elements, GPL-3.0; derived from the HyperSpy/EDSpy tables, Bearden 1967 and Zschornack 2007).
sources.edges: K, L3 and M5 absorption edge energies: xraylib EdgeEnergy (BSD-3-Clause; Elam, Ravel & Sieber 2002, Radiat. Phys. Chem. 63, 121).
sources.fluor_yield: K-shell fluorescence yields: xraylib FluorYield (BSD-3-Clause; Krause 1979, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 8, 307).
sources.mu_rho: Total mass attenuation coefficient mu/rho in cm^2/g, 0.1-30 keV, 200 log-spaced points, refined by bisection wherever log-log interpolation would be off by more than 0.3 %, plus points on both sides of every discontinuity of the xraylib table that is larger than 3 % between adjacent scan samples (0.5 eV spacing up to 2 keV, 0.05 % above), i.e. K, L and M edges with a visible step; the steps are located in the table itself because they lie up to ~10 eV from the nominal edge energy. Smaller steps (most heavy-element M edges) and N-shell edges are not resolved. Source: xraylib CS_Total (BSD-3-Clause; Schoonjans et al. 2011, Spectrochim. Acta B 66, 776).
